segment.source: For letter type Avatar, when the letters are too long to display, the font size can be automatically adjusted according to the width of the Avatar. You can also use gap to set the unit distance between left and right sides.
segment.target: Para letter tipo Avatar, quando o letters são too longo para exibir, o font tamanho pode ser automatically adjusted according para o largura de o Avatar. Você pode also usar gap para definir o unit distance between esquerda e direita sides.

segment.source: Three sizes and two shapes are available.
segment.target: Três tamanhos e dois shapes são disponível.

segment.source: Load avatar images directly from HTTPS URLs through the shared image-loading pipeline.
segment.target: Carregue imagens de avatar diretamente de URLs HTTPS pelo pipeline compartilhado de carregamento de imagens.

segment.source: Avatar provides compact identity visuals for users, teams, and objects. It supports circle and square shapes, explicit sizes, automatic text scaling, and grouped overflow display.
segment.target: Avatar provides compacto identity visuals para usuários, teams, e objects. Isso oferece suporte círculo e quadrado shapes, explicit tamanhos, automatic texto scaling, e grouped overflow exibir.

segment.source: Represent people or entities with image, icon, or text avatars.
segment.target: Represent people ou entities com imagem, ícone, ou texto avatars.

segment.source: Image, Icon and letter are supported, and the latter two kinds of avatar can have custom colors and background colors.
segment.target: Imagem, Ícone e letter são supported, e o latter dois kinds de avatar pode have personalizado cores e background cores.
